title: Elitewheels Drive 50D II disc brake carbon spoke road wheelset
notes: Official specification table: hooked bead, 50 mm depth, 23 mm inner and 31 mm outer width, 1,300 ±30 g pair without tubeless valves and rim tape (both listed as installed), 120 kg limit including rider, bike, gear and accessories, Kinetic 50T star-ratchet hub with S&S ceramic bearings, 4.5 mm carbon spokes 21F/24R with four spares, Center Lock, 12x100/12x142 mm, compatible tires 700x28-45C. US$1,299 on the official direct store. No maximum tire pressure or mainland China price is published.
